EZ Contractor Binder — Desktop UI

Complete desktop screen set · turns 8–16

High-fidelity desktop screens for EZ Contractor Binder. Every long single-column page is broken into tabs, and every addition beyond today's product is badged NEW so it can be accepted or dropped one at a time. Newest work sits at the top.

What is here

  • Turn 16 — Change order detail · Estimate Scope of Work, Terms, Notes
  • Turn 15 — Dashboard · Schedule · Field Ops · Timeclock · Billing
  • Turn 14 — Projects · Estimates · Contacts · Subs & Vendors · Team · Cost Catalog
  • Turn 13 — Project Money: Budget & Cost, Change Orders, Invoices, Payments, Profitability
  • Turn 12 — Project Documents: Files, Photos, photo markup sheet
  • Turn 11 — Project Overview and Work › Schedule (18 flat tabs → 6 sections)
  • Turn 10 — Notifications · Expenses (Receipts, Bills & Commitments, Review queue)
  • Turn 9 — Estimate detail: Details, Line Items, Sub Bids, Proposal
  • Turn 8 — Company Settings, seven tabs

These three numbers were previously buried in the terms paragraph, where nothing could read them. As fields they populate the deposit invoice, the retainage held on every draw, and the due date — no re-typing, and the printed terms stay in sync.
Estimate validity
This estimate is valid for 30 days from the date issued. Material pricing is subject to change after that period.
Change orders
Any change to the scope described above requires a signed change order before that work begins. Verbal approvals will not be performed.
Warranty
Workmanship is warranted for one year from substantial completion. Manufacturer warranties on materials and appliances pass through to the owner.

Payroll Week
Week starts on
Monday
Tuesday
Wednesday
Thursday
Friday
Changing this re-groups all past time into the new weeks and re-derives overtime for those periods. Weeks already approved keep their approvals, but their totals are shown under the new grouping.
Overtime
Weekly threshold (hours)
40
Paid hours above this weekly total count as overtime. Overtime is derived at read time — it is never selected on a timesheet.
Breaks
Breaks are paid
Paid break minutes per day
30
When on, break time up to the daily cap counts as paid hours (and toward overtime). Break time never counts against a job's cost either way. Break pay rules vary by state — short rest breaks are often legally paid even when this is off. Confirm your policy with a payroll or legal professional.
Location at Clock In/Out
Off
Never capture location.
Capture
Record location when the browser allows it — never required, never blocks.
Require (mobile app, future)
Will require location in the mobile app. On desktop this behaves like Capture.

CLIENT CONTRACTS
Turn this on if your company sends a written contract alongside its proposals. EZ Binder does not supply contract wording — you upload your own counsel-approved form and place boxes over its blanks, the same way release forms work.
Use client contracts
While this is off, proposals send exactly as they do today. Nothing about contracts appears anywhere else in the app.
CONTRACT FORMS
Upload the agreements your company uses. The uploaded PDF is the legal instrument — EZ Binder fills the blanks you mark on it and never rewrites the wording.
You can set these up whether or not client contracts are switched on above. Only sending a contract is affected by that switch.
